governance.purpose: Empirical filter across candidate physical frameworks; BFSS not privileged.
governance.verified_source_type: Publications, collaboration official releases and collaboration preliminary/preprint results individually attributed.
governance.qualifications: This is a curated, nonexhaustive snapshot of directly sourced example constraints, not a current world average or statistical global fit.
governance.claim_ceiling: A consistency input ledger; it proves neither the Standard Model nor any unification hypothesis. CI validates schema and source-record checks, not the truth of external data or a theory's agreement.
governance.online_recheck_policy: Primary source text manually reviewed as-of date; source URLs retained, not a live automatically re-fetched experimental database.

constraints.observable: CMS Higgs boson mass, combined diphoton and four-lepton channels

source.title: CMS Collaboration, Higgs mass Run 1+2 combination HIG-26-010

details.input: H→γγ and H→ZZ→4ℓ at 7, 8 and 13 TeV; single experiment
details.aggregation: CMS combination, not PDG or ATLAS+CMS world average

interpretation.model_test: A candidate with a Higgs particle needs an observable mass compatible with this channel-specific CMS measurement
interpretation.limitation: Higgs mass is an empirical free parameter in the SM, not predicted by the basic model; source is a 2026 preliminary CMS combination.

constraints.observable: CMS W boson mass from W→μν

source.title: CMS Collaboration, High-precision measurement of the W boson mass, Nature 652 (2026)

details.aggregation: single CMS measurement, not world average or electroweak fit

interpretation.model_test: Constrain electroweak loop and mass relationships under the candidate's specified inputs
interpretation.limitation: W mass measurements include known inter-experiment tension (notably CDF); a single CMS value must not be presented as consensus.

constraints.observable: CMS inclusive Higgs signal strength relative to SM at assumed Higgs mass 125.38 GeV

source.title: CMS Collaboration, Combined measurements and interpretations of Higgs production and decay, HIG-21-018 (2026 revision)

details.input: 138 fb^-1 2016–2018 pp at 13 TeV; combined multiple Higgs channels
details.aggregation: CMS inclusive signal strength; correlated with other CMS Higgs channels

interpretation.model_test: A fully specified Higgs model should predict the inclusive production×decay rates, with theory errors and correlations
interpretation.limitation: This fit assumes 125.38 GeV, different from 2026 HIG-26-010 measured 125.065 GeV; do not combine as statistically independent or substitute the mass without recomputing the analysis.

constraints.observable: JUNO solar neutrino mixing angle sin²θ12 from first 59.1 days

source.title: JUNO Collaboration, Measurement of reactor neutrino oscillation with the first JUNO data, Nature 654 (2026)

details.aggregation: single experiment; correlated with JUNO Δm²21 below

interpretation.model_test: Any neutrino mass/mixing mechanism must reproduce this angle under the specified oscillation model
interpretation.limitation: Not a direct absolute-neutrino-mass measurement, and not evidence of a specific mass-generation mechanism.

constraints.observable: JUNO solar neutrino mass-squared splitting Δm²21

source.title: JUNO Collaboration, Measurement of reactor neutrino oscillation with the first JUNO data, Nature 654 (2026)

details.aggregation: single experiment; correlated with JUNO sin²θ12 above

interpretation.model_test: A concrete neutrino sector must yield this mass-squared splitting after specifying ordering and mixing conventions
interpretation.limitation: Oscillation splitting alone does not give absolute neutrino masses; correlated JUNO parameters should not be treated as statistically independent.

source.title: Super-Kamiokande, proton decay p→e+π0 (Phys Rev D 102, 112011)

details.input: 450 kton·years, SK I–IV and enlarged fiducial volume
details.aggregation: 2020 channel-specific published bound; do not label newest 2026 global limit

interpretation.model_test: A specified GUT proton-decay partial-lifetime prediction in exactly this two-body channel must respect the channel-specific bound
interpretation.limitation: Not a bound on total proton lifetime or on two-pion/other decay channels; applies to τ/B at stated CL.

source.title: Super-Kamiokande, proton decay p→e+π0π0 in 0.401 megaton-years, Phys Rev D 114, 072009 (2026)

details.input: 0.401 Mton·years SK I–V pure water phases

interpretation.model_test: Exclude dynamical parameter points producing a partial lifetime in precisely p→e+π0π0 below this lower bound
interpretation.limitation: Not interchangeable with p→e+π0; different final-state multiplicity and experimental efficiencies.

source.title: Super-Kamiokande, proton decay p→μ+π0π0 in 0.401 megaton-years, Phys Rev D 114, 072009 (2026)

details.input: 0.401 Mton·years SK I–V pure water phases
details.aggregation: specific three-body, muon and two-pion proton-decay search

interpretation.model_test: Compare a specifically calculated p→μ+π0π0 partial lifetime against this bound, with the same final-state kinematics.
interpretation.limitation: Not interchangeable with the electron channel or two-body p→μ+π0.

constraints.observable: Super-Kamiokande partial lifetime p→e+X (massless invisible X)

source.title: Super-Kamiokande, proton decay to charged antilepton + massless invisible X, Phys Rev D 114, 072005 (2026)

details.aggregation: assumes massless invisible neutral X in final state

interpretation.model_test: Test only candidate models with the specified invisible massless neutral X and p→e+X decay kinematics
interpretation.limitation: Cannot be applied indiscriminately to an arbitrary massive invisible particle or other channel.

constraints.observable: Fermilab muon EDM absolute upper limit

source.title: Fermilab Muon g-2 collaboration, 2026 official muon electric dipole moment release

details.input: 25% of experiment data; reported d_mu=(-0.35±0.39)×10^-19 e·cm
details.aggregation: direct muon EDM result, distinct from muon anomalous magnetic moment

interpretation.model_test: CP-violating candidate physics with a predicted muon EDM must respect the absolute bound under the same convention
interpretation.limitation: Release month known, day not asserted here; not an upper bound on electron EDM or on other CP-odd observables.

open_requirements.why: SM-Y0 verifies one given family only; three-generation origin remains unproved.
Experimentally fitted masses and signal strengths do not derive Yukawa couplings.
JUNO measures oscillation mixing and squared-mass differences, not individual absolute masses.
Version-specific PDG tables and covariance must be sourced before numeric model exclusion.
No BFSS or Spin(10) map to physical 3+1-dimensional chiral SM fields has been qualified.
Collider and neutrino inputs alone cannot validate a quantum-gravity framework.
